## The question

[Double subscript error using tensor package](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/109000/double-subscript-error-using-tensor-package), asked by [James Fielder](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/29115/james-fielder) on TeX Stack Exchange (2013-04-16; [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)):

> I have been attempting to typeset tensors using the [tensor](http://anorien.csc.warwick.ac.uk/mirrors/CTAN/macros/latex/contrib/tensor/tensor.pdf) package and have come across an error when attempting to create subscripts on the subscripts of my tensors.
>
> An example of this would be the following:
>
> ```latex
> \documentclass{report}
> \usepackage{mathtools}
> \usepackage{tensor}
>
> \begin{document}
>
> \begin{equation} \label{tensor-symmetrize}
> T\indices{_{(\mu_1 \mu_2 \cdots \mu_n)}_\rho^\sigma} = \frac{1}{n!} (T \indices{_{\mu_1}_{\mu_2}}_{\cdots}_{\mu_n}_\rho^\sigma 
> + \text{sum over permutations of indices}) .
> \end{equation}
>
> \end{document}
> ```
>
> On compiling this document I get an error saying 
>
> ```latex
> ! Double subscript.
> l.8 ...frac{1}{n!} (T \indices{_{\mu_1}_{\mu_2}}_
>                                               {\cdots}_{\mu_n}_\rho^\sig...
> ```
:::

You have a misbalance in braces:

```latex
\begin{equation} \label{tensor-symmetrize}
T\indices{_{(\mu_1 \mu_2 \cdots \mu_n)}_\rho^\sigma} = \frac{1}{n!} (T \indices{_{\mu_1}_{\mu_2}_{\cdots}_{\mu_n}_\rho^\sigma }
+ \text{sum over permutations of indices}) .
\end{equation}
```

You could take out the extra braces and subscripts on the right-hand side like this:

```latex
\begin{equation} 
T\indices{_{(\mu_1 \mu_2 \cdots \mu_n)}_\rho^\sigma} = \frac{1}{n!} (T \indices{_{\mu_1\mu_2\cdots\mu_n}_\rho^\sigma }
+ \text{sum over permutations of indices})
\end{equation}
```
